copilot.readyToCheck: Click "Run Environment Check" to detect your local GitHub Copilot CLI environment
copilot.step1: Make sure GitHub CLI (gh) is installed: https://cli.github.com/
copilot.step2: Install Copilot extension and sign in: gh auth login && gh extension install github/gh-copilot
copilot.step3: After checks pass, click "Enable" to use Copilot models in the Agent dialog
copilot.notInstalled: GitHub Copilot CLI not detected. Please install it first.
copilot.notConfigured: GitHub Copilot is not configured. Please complete environment check and enable it in Settings first.
copilot.extensionInstalled: Copilot extension installed successfully. Please re-run the environment check.
copilot.authOpened: Terminal window opened. Please complete GitHub login there.
